title: Blank call tapes after dispatch embedding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $C$ be a finite Turing machine over that alphabet with a positive number of work tapes. For a Boolean input $x$, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$, let $s$ be either Boolean value, and let $d$ be a four-tape configuration whose states are dispatch states. If the fourth work tape of $d$ is blank at every integer position and its head is at position $0$, then, for every index $j$ among the $1+C.k$ call-bank tapes, the corresponding tape in the dispatch configuration embedded into the host machine is blank everywhere and its head is at position $0$.
